select s.id as submission_id, s.match_id, m.match_no, m.round_no, m.match_time, d.division_name, m.platform_code, ht.team_name_snapshot as home_team_name, at.team_name_snapshot as away_team_name, st.team_name_snapshot as submit_team_name, ep.player_name_snapshot as submitter_name, s.submitter_role, s.version_no, s.submission_status, s.submit_time, s.audit_time from basket_match_submission s join basket_match m on m.id = s.match_id and m.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division d on d.id = s.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team ht on ht.id = m.home_event_team_id and ht.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team at on at.id = m.away_event_team_id and at.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team st on st.id = s.submit_event_team_id and st.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_player ep on ep.id = s.submit_event_player_id and ep.is_delete = 0 where s.is_delete = 0 and s.season_id = #{seasonId} and s.division_id = #{divisionId} and s.match_id = #{matchId} and s.submit_event_team_id = #{submitEventTeamId} and s.submission_status = #{submissionStatus} and st.team_name_snapshot like concat('%', #{teamName}, '%') and m.match_no like concat('%', #{matchNo}, '%') order by s.submit_time desc, s.id desc
